first.rationale: Prioritize verification of the directly relevant onboarding result and the consequential pricing alternative. Current declines in onboarding completion and activation make onboarding simplification the most direct route to restoring early adoption and sustainable qualified revenue; guard against reduced qualification or weaker downstream account quality.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified prior experiment improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%; the current 4% completion decline and 6% activation decline make this the most directly responsive sustainable-revenue intervention. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified 18% qualified-revenue lift was paired with 12% lower 30-day retention and failure to survive the first renewal cycle. Evaluate qualification and longer-horizon retention/revenue alongside completion and activation before any rollout.
